facts.fact: Angola's presentation to the registrars general meeting of 18 July 2026 states that the government has implemented a multifunctional database under the management of the Ministry of Justice as the centre of digital identity, with the civil registration system listed first among its existing systems.

Angola's presentation of 18 July 2026 states that biographic and biometric data are collected and validated at the act of issuing the birth entry (assento de nascimento), under phase I of the digital identity architecture, covering all national citizens; it gives no count of offices and does not mention deaths.

systems.tiers: not stated; listed as an existing system in phase I, with data collected at the act of issuing the birth entry

systems.system: base de dados multifuncional da Identidade Digital
systems.tiers: national; three phases, from existing systems to a digital identity card, wallet app and online service platform

note: The presentation sets out a target architecture and its phases; it does not say whether the record is made online or locally, nor how many offices use the system. Also listed, outside the study's field: criminal record, vehicle and notarial systems.
